rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for doing something in a disorderly or uncontrolled way.

example.english: They wildly make things up, so nobody knows which part is true.
example.traditional: 佢亂咁作故仔，搞到冇人知邊句真。
example.jyutping: keoi5 lyun6 gam3 zok3 gu3 zai2 gaau2 dou3 mou5 jan4 zi1 bin1 geoi3 zan1

rows.note: Use this colloquial intensifier before an adjective when “wildly” means extremely, as in “wildly exaggerated.”

example.jyutping: go3 gaa3 cin2 ging6 kwaa1 zoeng1
